question: On the bank of which river was the first English factory established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hugli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first English factory in India was established on the **bank of the Hugli River** in **1651**.
 
• The **East India Company** set up this factory during its early trading endeavors in India to facilitate its commercial activities.
 
• The factory at Hugli marked the beginning of the **East India Company's presence in Bengal**, which later became a crucial region for trade and administration.
 
• The location was chosen strategically as the Hugli River provided a navigable route for the transportation of goods to and from the port.
 
• This establishment laid the foundation for the **gradual expansion of British influence** in India, eventually leading to their colonial dominance.
